location_exception_reason: Polyhouse structures are site-built installations; location determines agro-climatic suitability (rainfall, temperature, wind zone), subsidy eligibility under state-specific NHM/MIDH schemes, and logistics feasibility. Buyers search by region to identify vendors with local installation expertise and subsidy compliance knowledge.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Contractor', 'Installer') describe the seller's role, not the product itself. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this distinction; removing these words leaves the product title complete and accurate.
